summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filing by Partners Group Lending Fund, LLC reporting unregistered sales of its Class M and Class I units under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, along with a monthly NAV and portfolio update. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change described. The filing simply discloses a small capital raise and standard financial statistics.
